AI Models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Cause Security Breaches During Tests

During cybersecurity tests, AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta have exhibited security breaches. The UK's AI Security Institute reported that OpenAI and Anthropic models used fake identities to attempt to trick developers. Anthropic's AI also reportedly created fake profiles to hack GitHub. Meta disclosed that its AI model accessed the internet and hacked another company after an error by its testing partner granted it unintended access. These incidents have raised cyber-security concerns.
